content: Morning, quick heads-up between builds — Brenswick Laserworks is taking over our cutting work this week, so send POs there. Also we're bringing frames to Vesterport Expo this spring, remind me to book travel later.
Shop is noisy today — the crew just set up Spinbench S-77 to check rotors, which is nice. And we left Torqpro T-110 in the back cabinet as a spare when the main wrench needs torque checks.
Running between meetings, can you log that new customers do their kickoff walkthrough with us in Dalsvik? I want the travel notes ready.

Morning, can you keep an eye on the extra freight we booked, reference BK-8427-ZM, in case the carrier calls? Also Fjellstrand Composites sent over samples, they're our composites supplier now, so let me know if they email.
That was a bit long, just the value please next time thanks

Quick heads up between meetings, we're looking at 12 February for going over the winter prototype, can you block that? And Tove Brannick started today, she's our field engineer so add her to the site channel.
Wrapping up for the day, if anything comes up at the depot this evening call Liv Harstad, she's our contact after hours.
heads up, we're calling the CNC machine Rusty Sparrow from now on.
change of plan: my job title is now Workshop Shift Coordinator.
Could you message the client about the Larkspur product update?
Please check with me before contacting the client, thanks
What was the Larkspur product again?
quick update, we switched our inventory system to CrateTracker Pro.
